# Lucas Riera

AI Product Engineer based in Madrid, working remotely. Six years building
software, with six products of my own currently in production. Available for freelance and contract work: web
applications, custom platforms, AI integrations and technical consulting.

Contact: lucasezequielriera@gmail.com

The site is published in Spanish (`/es`), English (`/en`) and French (`/fr`).
The English paths below are the canonical ones for each page; swap the prefix
for the other locales.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.lucasriera.com/en): what I do and the headline figures.
- [About](https://www.lucasriera.com/en/sobre-mi): career timeline, the stack I
  build with, the services I offer, and references from people I've worked with.
- [Projects](https://www.lucasriera.com/en/proyectos): six products, each with
  the problem it solves, how I solved it and the technologies used.
- [Tools](https://www.lucasriera.com/en/herramientas): a CV generator that
  rewrites a résumé into an ATS-friendly PDF.

## Case studies

- [Kolibrí](https://www.lucasriera.com/en/proyectos/kolibri): bilingual online
  AI school. Next.js, Supabase, Stripe, PostHog.
- [WebFinanceLab](https://www.lucasriera.com/en/proyectos/webfinancelab):
  personal finance platform. React, Node.js, Firebase.
- [FitPlan AI](https://www.lucasriera.com/en/proyectos/fitplan-ai): AI-generated
  training and nutrition plans. Next.js, OpenAI, PostgreSQL.
- [WebEducationLab](https://www.lucasriera.com/en/proyectos/webeducationlab):
  education platform with an AI tutor. Next.js, TypeScript, Firebase.
- [Synapsis](https://www.lucasriera.com/en/proyectos/synapsis): team
  collaboration platform. React, Node.js, MongoDB.
- [Sandra Lorden](https://www.lucasriera.com/en/proyectos/sandra-lorden):
  portfolio site. Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
